name: value-utilities/filters-opacity-outline
description: Filter (blur/brightness/contrast/grayscale/hue-rotate/invert/saturate/sepia/drop-shadow), backdrop-filter, opacity, and outline. Filter utilities follow the same compose-via-CSS-vars pattern as transforms — each writes its `--tw-<name>` and re-asserts the full `filter` shorthand. `blur-none` (empty theme value) writes `' '` to the var per upstream's `value.trim() === ''` branch. Drop-shadow theme values are arrays joined with ` `, each wrapped in `drop-shadow(...)`. Outline-color is the only color plugin in v3 that opts out of `withAlphaVariable` — emits the raw value via `toColorValue`.
